source_sql:
-- [ORA]

-- A-5. 正規表現
SELECT email,
       REGEXP_SUBSTR(email, '^[A-Z]')           AS first_char,
       REGEXP_REPLACE(last_name, '[aeiou]', '*') AS masked
FROM   employees
WHERE  REGEXP_LIKE(last_name, '^(K|L)')
